      "type": "question",
      "kind": "usefulness",
      "text": "Why is an 11-minute load considered too slow, and is that preventing adoption enough to justify complexity in load-bearing code?",
      "quote": "Why do you consider an 11-minute load too slow? Is there a reason to think this is what's preventing people from using it - enough to justify yet more complexity in the most \"load-bearing\" parts of the code?",
      "clears_with": "answer",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied explaining that excessive compactions and memory usage cause unnecessary slowness",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6363949408"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6363949408",
      "status_by_quote": "I don't consider it too slow; though it's possible it could be on slower systems than the ones I test on."
    },
    {
      "id": "c:6359437508",
      "part": 2,
      "type": "objection",
      "kind": "maintenance",
      "text": "Adds AssumeUTXO-specific complexity and pollutes the codebase with multiple chainstates, making consensus-critical paths harder to reason about",
      "quote": "This change adds *even* more AssumeUTXO-specific complexity, which is exactly why we're considering removing it completely. ... many of us are not comfortable polluting the code with multiple chainstates, which make consensus-critical paths harder to reason about.",
      "clears_with": "change",
      "status": "answered",
      "status_note": "author replied arguing AssumeUTXO is a better solution for fast node startup than IBD optimizations",
      "author_replies": [
        "c:6363949408"
      ],
      "other_replies": [],
      "fix_pushed": false,
      "status_by_id": "c:6363949408",
      "status_by_quote": "I think the assumeutxo approach is a much better approach to resolving the \"fast startup of a new node\" challenge than trying to get a few extra percent out of IBD performance"
    }
  ],
  "support": [],
  "notes": "Initial record. l0rinc questioned the motivation and objected to adding AssumeUTXO complexity to consensus-critical paths; ajtowns replied defending the approach.",
  "waiting_on": [

      "what": "l0rinc to respond to ajtowns' defense of AssumeUTXO and performance improvements",

    }
  ]
}
